$comment: Default gate ladder policy (unified-platform-spec.md §6.4). The raw bytes of this file are hashed into every GateReport (INV-10). Commands are resolved against the TARGET repo the core is gating; 'fallback:full_unit' means targeted-test selection is not implemented in Phase 0 and the full unit suite runs instead (spec §6.4 T0). T2/T3 are explicit stubs in Phase 0 — they must report not_enabled, never pass silently.
